protocol.question: fixed-camera subsystem and gripper-to-fixed full-chain consistency on held-out board and cube before external GT
protocol.camera_intersection_reason: every method must be evaluated on identical fixed-camera pairs
protocol.why_two_camera_scopes_are_reported: fixed-to-fixed isolates fixed-camera calibration; gripper-to-fixed evaluates the combined hand-eye, FK, and fixed-camera chain

fixed_to_fixed_board_cube.limitation: cannot measure absolute physical accuracy or detect a systematic calibration error shared by every fixed camera

gripper_to_fixed_board_cube.limitation: cannot separate hand-eye calibration error from robot FK error and is not independent absolute accuracy

reference_dependent_reprojection_px.limitation: shared train-only target poses are not neutral external references and can favor aligned assumptions

legacy_cube_e_cross_pose_consistency.limitation: cannot detect a systematic calibration error shared by every fixed camera

fk_dependent_e2e_path_closure.limitation: contains robot FK and is not independent absolute accuracy

definition.name: shared_train_target_pose_reprojection_diagnostic
definition.limitation: the board and cube base-frame poses are train-derived internal references and may be closer to methods that share their assumptions

definition.name: fk_dependent_gripper_to_fixed_board_cube_cross_target
definition.interpretation: visual target observations evaluate the combined fixed-camera, hand-eye, and robot-FK chain; FK error cannot be separated here

fixed_to_fixed.overall_note: pooled board+cube pixel transfer is descriptive only; use each target component for comparison

metric_contract.name: fk_dependent_gripper_to_fixed_board_cube_cross_target
metric_contract.interpretation: visual target observations evaluate the combined fixed-camera, hand-eye, and robot-FK chain; FK error cannot be separated here

gripper_to_fixed.interpretation: visual cross-view residual through the calibrated hand-eye and robot FK chain; it is not an FK-free or absolute-accuracy metric

metric_contract.name: shared_train_target_pose_reprojection_diagnostic
